parameters.name: ResourceMatcher
parameters.description: The resource matcher. Required. A matching rule in JSON format that supports TAG (tag) conditions and BOOL (Boolean) combinations. TAG conditions support three operators: EQUAL (tag key-value pair is equal), KEY_EXIST (tag key exists), and KEY_EXIST_NOT_EQUAL (tag key exists but the value is not equal). BOOL conditions support only the AND operator, which indicates that all sub-conditions must be matched.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Optional. If specified, the resource category matches only resources of this type. If not specified, the resource type is not restricted, and the matcher can match resources of all types.
